title: Directional selection
caption: One extreme is favoured, so the whole distribution shifts and the mean moves towards it. Antibiotic resistance in bacteria is an example.
alt: Two bell curves of a trait: a dashed curve before selection centred on 50 and a solid curve after directional selection centred on 58.
description: Before: the trait is spread around a mean of 50.
Directional selection favours high values, so after selection the mean has moved to 58.

checks.name: after directional selection the mean has moved to 58 and the curve keeps its shape
